verdict.rationale: Snowflake ships Cortex Analyst for natural-language Q&A over data, Cortex AI Functions for LLM-powered unstructured analytics, and Semantic Views to ground these insights in business context, directly delivering in-product AI-generated insights and suggestions. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of insight quality and no evidence of proactive/unprompted suggestion surfacing (only query-driven Q&A is documented).
